notes:
Edit sent messages for up to five minutes, only until another participant reads them. Preserve the Edited label and original text in audit history; use Reply to send corrections after a message locks.

Show quiet typing and voice-recording indicators in private chats and groups, naming participants and summarizing multiple people. Clear typing after three seconds, recording when capture stops, and stale activity within ten seconds. Indicators share no drafts or unfinished audio, create no activity history, and never mark messages read. Desktop and web enforce current conversation access and group membership on the server.

Replace the large background-notification warning with a compact bell beside the profile. Hover or click for details; it clears automatically when all failed background requests recover.

Requires backend 13.46.170 and the chat_message_revisions migration deployed together with the chat services, controllers, Livewire view, JavaScript and routes. Production backend deployment remains separate from this desktop release.

Validation on 07-10-2026: 103 frontend tests, 29 native tests, 155 isolated backend chat tests (1,435 assertions), and 21 web activity/recorder tests passed. Fictional-data browser checks verified message edit/correction flows, named group activity, disconnect expiry and the compact header warning with automatic recovery. Production frontend and signed Windows builds passed. Executable version, installer signature, bound update version and SHA-256 checksums verified; altered installer bytes were rejected. Installer execution was not performed. Existing backend PHP deprecations remain.
